# Bonova

> Bonova is a free invoice, quote and receipt maker (French and English) for freelancers and small businesses in Africa and worldwide. Make an invoice and send it by WhatsApp, email or PDF in a minute, without creating an account. Unlimited free invoices, 0% fees: clients pay the seller directly by Mobile Money (MTN MoMo, Orange Money, Wave, M-Pesa, Moov, Airtel…), bank transfer/IBAN, PayPal, Wise, or a Stripe/Paystack/Flutterwave/Kkiapay/FedaPay link. All African currencies plus USD, EUR, GBP, CAD and more. Country-aware tax and legal lines (OHADA, France, EU reverse charge, UK, US, Canada). Pro (price shown in the local currency, e.g. 2,500 FCFA or $4.90/month): unlimited templates, signature and stamp, custom footer, no Bonova branding. Paid by Mobile Money in the West African CFA zone (XOF), card or PayPal elsewhere.

## Limits
- Not a certified e-invoicing system (e.g. MECeF in Benin, FNE in Côte d'Ivoire, French e-invoicing platforms).
